### ✨ New Features

* add `Bypass screen recording detection` patch ([8fd4e73](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/8fd4e734929393b46d9c0dbe9a5ac9fb92e1a1e9))

* update `MEGA`'s `Unlock Pro` so it lets you unlock different tiers of pro. ([bb18b39](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/bb18b39258c7d00a13de7a4df94a91de3661adce))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* lint stage in github releases ([4ab2d92](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/4ab2d92ddbb1288462bb7332385a94a4ce3a665d))

patches.name: Remove clip bumper
patches.description: Removes the Postparty logo bumper from all exports. NOTE: I SUCK AT CODING, USE *MODIFIED* CLIPS. TRIM A SECOND OR ADD A STICKER!

patches.name: Enable media sniffer
patches.description: Restores Pawxy's hidden media sniffer to the toolbar.

patches.name: Rate-us popup
patches.description: Removes or rewrites the rate-us popup text.

options.description: Prevents the rate-us dialog from ever appearing. Off = rewrite mode (change text instead of removing).
Replaces rate_app_title and rate_head. Only used if remove is off.
Replaces rate_request and rate_app_propose. Only used if remove is off.
Replaces rate_rate_now. Only used if remove is off.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks Pawxy premium features (VPN servers, removes paywall and upsell badges).

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses PortDroid's signature check so the re-signed app passes validation.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks all MEGA Pro features and removes ads.

options.description: Which Pro tier to spoof. PRO III is the highest consumer tier.
